# Jobs at WellnessLiving

Want to join our team? We have [20 open jobs!](https://jobs.gohire.io/wellnessliving-zvcrxvet/#jobs)

## About Us

**About WellnessLiving**

At WellnessLiving, we build technology that helps wellness businesses thrive and we do it with purpose.

We are an all-in-one business management software platform serving wellness, fitness, health, and beauty businesses around the world. From online booking and client management to payments, marketing, loyalty programs, reporting,  and AI-powered business tools, WellnessLiving enables businesses to run their entire operation from a single, powerful system.

What truly sets us apart is how we pair innovative technology with hands-on onboarding, training, and ongoing customer support. Our customers are entrepreneurs who pour their energy into helping others feel their best, and our mission is to support them every step of the way.

Today, WellnessLiving supports more than 7,500 wellness businesses and serves over 25 million end users globally. Our growth has been driven by innovation, strong customer retention, and referrals from businesses that trust us as a long-term partner.

We have been recognized on the Deloitte Technology Fast 50™ list as one of Canada’s fastest-growing technology companies and later on the Deloitte Technology Fast 500™ list across North America. We are also proud of the consistently strong customer satisfaction reviews we receive, particularly for reliability, feature depth, and support.

**Why Work at WellnessLiving**

Working at WellnessLiving means joining a team that cares deeply about what we build and who we build it for.

You will work alongside talented, driven people who take ownership, move quickly, and value collaboration. You will have the opportunity to make a real impact on an industry that improves people’s lives every day. And you will grow with a company that is scaling thoughtfully, investing in its people, and building for the long term.

**Our Core Values**

Our core values guide how we work, how we make decisions, and how we support one another.

- **Customer First**: We approach every challenge with a customer-focused lens, driven by a deep commitment to our customers’ happiness and success.
- **Excellence**: We hold ourselves to a high standard in everything we do, with a relentless focus on quality, impact, and continuous improvement.
- **Accountability**: We take full ownership of our decisions, actions, and outcomes, learning from both our successes and our failures.
- **Adaptability**: We embrace change and evolve with purpose, recognizing that long-term success requires flexibility in a dynamic world.

**Join Us**

If you are passionate about technology, motivated by impact, and excited to contribute to a growing company that supports wellness businesses around the world, WellnessLiving could be the place for you.

We invite you to explore our open roles and become part of a team that is building meaningful technology, supporting vibrant communities, and shaping the future of wellness.
